text: Prepared human step as structured data: action, artifact links (draft URL, file), question and options, shown in the review inbox
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: the loop correctly demands that every idea waiting on the human has its step prepared. In practice the agent stuffed long text into status comments: a whole draft message to Felix Fritsch, email text for the EYE office, Gmail draft references, file paths, 'DECISION: (a)/(b)/(c)'. The inbox (90cf0309) shows that as one blob. The human can't click to the Gmail draft or pick an option.

Proposal: an optional structured humanStep on an idea: {kind: send | decide | do, summary, artifacts: [{label, url or path}], options: [{label, consequence}], recommended}. The MCP accepts it in update_idea. The review inbox renders it: buttons to open artifacts, option chips that record the choice as the status comment and move the idea back to open for the agent.

Refuted if humans prefer the free-text comment.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude 2026-11-23 from a cross-repo session (see description).
